title: Restore cmd_scaffold's 3md lessons: move the second z=5 plane to z=6
description: Restore cmd_scaffold's 3md lessons: move the second z=5 plane to z=6
no_spec_change_rationale: A duplicate z makes threemd refuse the file, so cmd_scaffold's lessons silently fall back to context.md. Renumbering one plane restores the existing lesson source; no contract or requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: specs/cmd_scaffold/cmd_scaffold.3md has unique plane positions (z=0 to z=6) and parses, so a change briefing for cmd_scaffold reads its lessons from cmd_scaffold.3md instead of falling back to context.md; check --strict still passes

answers.constraints: Lesson planes are append-only: keep every plane's text and order and change only the duplicate z position; threemd requires unique plane positions
